purpose: Pile an additional characteristic onto an evaluation, often a complaint.
keywords: N / plain clause + ときている
This room is small and, on top of that, dark.
He is often late and, what is more, never even apologizes.
It is light, sturdy, and even cheap.
formation: N / plain clause + ときている
restrictions: Often follows other reasons in a cumulative judgment.
mistake: It does not literally describe someone arriving.
